column1: # Claims this project has RETRACTED. A retired claim must not reappear in any live page or in the tools.
# Why a gate and not care: the hard-link claim below was reported corrected twice and was still on ELEVEN
# live pages and inside forefst.py -- including printed output -- when a third review found it. No existing
# check could see it: check_doc_drift compares sentences for NUMERIC disagreement (this claim has no
# numbers) and check_doc_vocabulary is scoped to retired output tokens INSIDE FENCED CODE BLOCKS.
#   pattern   Python regex, matched case-insensitively against text with hard wraps joined
#   unless    regex that, if found in the SAME sentence, means the text is stating the correction
#   retired_by  the measurement that retracted it
#   correct   one line: what to say instead

column5: A SetFileTime through one hard-link name updates EVERY name; divergence is evidence, agreement is not, and which name is authentic is not established.
Do not name an authentic birth from the sibling set; the mechanism behind the observed divergence was never decompiled.
The tool flags EVERY name of a diverging group; flagging only one would assert the others are clean.
A name-scoped SetFileTime updates EVERY name, so it cannot be the cause of a divergence; the mechanism is unknown.
